about: Doc 75, 5.3: the acceptance scorecard, agreed before any new run and checked first on the runs already on disk (the dry run, steer-accept-dry.json). Read by tools/steer_accept.py. Each mark's targets (the distribution measure's field, target and band; hungerMost, shortMost; the floors-off tills short) are in a targets file, written by tools/steer_calibrate.py from the calibration runs (steer-targets-t1.json for the dry run: doc 74's table and the t1 runs' own means).

rungs.full: the scorecard: T1-T8 on every run, T9-T13 on their runs
rungs.F2: the scorecard, one calibrated strength down
rungs.F1: the right without charters: no worse than steer-right-t1 in T4-T7 (its float days a year the ceiling)
rungs.F3: doc 74's t1 controller at that end: no worse than the t1 run at that end in T4-T7
